Mutable snapshot of all turret sensor readings, refreshed each loop by TurretIO.updateInputs(TurretIOInputs).

Thin wrapper around PhotonVision's EstimatedRobotPose that exposes only what the Vision subsystem needs: a 2D field pose and the image-capture timestamp.
